Case: Scott is a 55-year-old who is post-op day 4 status-post C3-C5 anterior cervical discectomy and fusion. On physical examination, you find that his neck remains tender to palpation and he continues to have dysesthesias in both arms. The medication administration record indicates that he has been taking 1 dose of oxycodone every 6 hours for pain control.
Question: Would you offer a oxycodone prescription to Scott? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
